skill.name: tieba-demand-insights
skill.description: Use SocialDataX to analyze Baidu Tieba posts and comments. Start with a keyword, forum name, or thread link to find product problems, purchase concerns, and common questions.
skill.summary: Turn Baidu Tieba discussions into research reports with short quotes and source references.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most flags are Markdown formatting, service references, Tieba thread identifiers, or readable Chinese text. The documented CLI runs an unpinned npm package that can access API credentials and provides shell templates for user-supplied values. No evidence found of embedded malware, credential exfiltration, or an attempt to manipulate this audit.

remediation.issue: The unpinned CLI runs with access to service credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Pin and verify an exact release before use. Require explicit approval before installing or executing it, and avoid automatic confirmation.

remediation.issue: The CLI can access environment credentials and a persistent local key.
remediation.suggestion: Use one documented credential source per session. Prefer scoped, short-lived keys or OS-backed secret storage, and verify file permissions if local storage remains.

remediation.issue: Shell templates accept user-supplied values without prescribing safe argument handling.
remediation.suggestion: Use a structured connector or pass an argument array without a shell. Validate numeric identifiers and restrict thread URLs to the expected Tieba host.

remediation.issue: Retrieved forum text is not explicitly separated from trusted instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Treat posts, comments, and replies as untrusted data. Never let their text trigger commands, disclosure, or new requests.

content.user_title: Find User Needs in Baidu Tieba Discussions
content.value_statement: Product problems and buying concerns are scattered across Baidu Tieba discussions. Group them into themes and check each finding against short quotes and source references.
actual_capabilities: Search Tieba by keyword or limit results to a named forum.
Retrieve thread details and comments from a link or thread ID.
Retrieve nested replies when a specific comment needs more context.
Group sampled feedback into use cases, product problems, purchase concerns, and common questions.
Cite short quotes, thread references, and comment identifiers when available.
Report sample size, missing evidence, and whether a statement reflects experience, a question, or interpretation.
limitations: Live retrieval requires an authenticated SocialDataX connection. Some requests may use account credits.
Searches are bounded, and missing comments or partial results limit coverage.
Mention counts describe the sample, not the wider Tieba population.
Research is read-only. The skill does not sign into Tieba or post, like, comment, or modify accounts.

use_cases.title: Identify recurring setup problems
use_cases.description: Review selected product discussions to find tasks users struggle with. Compare repeated problems and cite representative comments.

use_cases.title: Review concerns before purchase
use_cases.description: Compare questions across selected threads. Separate firsthand owner feedback from speculation and identify concerns to investigate further.

use_cases.title: Draft support FAQ topics
use_cases.description: Use a support thread and relevant replies to find repeated questions. Note which answers still need product documentation or testing.

prompt_templates.title: Review one discussion
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Tieba thread: [link]. Summarize the main question and cite two relevant comments if available.

prompt_templates.title: Sample one product forum
prompt_templates.prompt: Search one page of [forum] for [product keyword]. Select up to three relevant threads and list purchase concerns with source references.
prompt_templates.scenario: Find buyer questions in a named forum.

prompt_templates.title: Compare evidence across threads
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the discussions at [thread links]. Group recurring problems, separate firsthand reports from questions, and do not count repeated statements by one user as independent evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare feedback from a small set of discussions.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize research follow-ups
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [forum] for [topic] using at most two pages. Check relevant nested replies, rank needs by evidence strength, and report coverage gaps and follow-up questions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a research brief with clear retrieval limits.

output_examples.input: Review one example thread about pairing a wireless keyboard.
output: Illustrative sample: one thread and six comments.
Setup problem: Two commenters report losing the pairing after restart.
Evidence: "I have to pair it again after every restart." Source: example thread, comment 4.
Follow-up: Check whether the problem occurs on more than one operating system.

output_examples.input: Compare purchase questions in three example threads about air purifiers.
output: Illustrative sample: three threads and eight comments.
Purchase concern: Buyers in two threads ask how much replacement filters cost.
Evidence: "How much will I spend on filters each year?" Source: example thread B, comment 2.
FAQ candidate: What does a replacement filter cost, and how often should it be replaced?
Evidence gap: The sample includes no confirmed replacement intervals.

best_practices: Start with one page or one known thread, then expand only when the first sample leaves important gaps.
Use a trusted, authenticated connection and keep API keys out of chat, logs, and research reports.
Label firsthand reports, questions, and interpretations separately, and note when source evidence is missing.
anti_patterns: Treating repeated comments from the same user as independent evidence.
Presenting sample counts as estimates for all Tieba users.
Inferring sensitive personal traits from usernames or discussion history.

faq.question: What can I provide to start?
faq.answer: Use a keyword, forum name, or Tieba thread link or ID.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX API key?
faq.answer: The CLI requires a configured key. An authenticated hosted MCP connection can use its existing credentials.

faq.question: Can it read replies to individual comments?
faq.answer: Yes. It can fetch nested replies when the thread and parent comment IDs are available.

faq.question: Do live requests cost credits?
faq.answer: Some SocialDataX requests may use account credits. If the balance is insufficient, stop and review your account before continuing.

faq.question: What happens if retrieval is incomplete?
faq.answer: The workflow keeps partial results, marks them incomplete, and resumes only when a continuation token and the original limits allow it.

faq.question: Can it post or change anything on Tieba?
faq.answer: No. The research workflow reads discussions and does not post, like, comment, or change a Tieba account.
